Name: Vanilla Tweaks Style Grapes of Ferngill
Author: MarsCBG
Description:
Replaces the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8684]Grapes of Ferngill[/url] Seeds and Saplings with ones in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21284]Vanilla Tweaks[/url] style.

Uses Cross-Mod Compatibility Tokens to pull the Saturation and Seasonal options directly from the main Vanilla Tweaks - Farming mod.
